Molecular biological identification of screened strains

Three strains were sent to Shanghai Sangon Biotech Co., Ltd. for sequencing, and the sequences of the three strains were obtained. Their lengths were 1486 base pairs (bp) for strain S1, 620 bp for strain S2, and 566 bp for strain S3, respectively. The specific results are presented later in this paper.

BLAST analysis against the NCBI database revealed that strain S1 shared 100% sequence similarity with the accession number MT375545.1, strain S2 showed 99.84% sequence similarity to the accession number MH047187.1, and strain S3 exhibited 99.81% sequence similarity with the accession number MN518398.1.

The obtained DNA sequences were subjected to a Blast alignment in the NCBI database to identify strains with high similarity to these three strains. The MEGA11 software was used to construct a phylogenetic tree, and the resulting phylogenetic tree is shown in the figure. Combining with their morphological characteristics, strain S1 was identified as belonging to the genus Bacillus, while strains S2 and S3 were identified as belonging to the genus Phanerodontia.
